Ihre Aufgaben Als Teil des IT-Teams liegt Ihr Schwerpunkt auf dem technischen Support auf Level 2 sowie auf der Administration und Wartung der internen IT-Infrastruktur. Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören: IT-Support auf Level 2 für interne Anwender sowie Bearbeitung komplexerer technischer Störungen. Analyse und Behebung von Problemen im Bereich Arbeitsplätze, Betriebssysteme, Software und IT-Infrastruktur . Administration und Wartung von Servern und internen IT-Systemen . Betreuung und Wartung virtualisierter Umgebungen, insbesondere VMware . Konfiguration, Wartung und Überwachung von virtuellen Maschinen . Installation, Konfiguration und Aktualisierung von Computern, Software und IT-Equipment . Einrichtung von Benutzerkonten und Konfiguration der Arbeitsplatzumgebungen. Überwachung der Systemleistung sowie Durchführung von präventiven und korrektiven IT-Wartungsmaßnahmen . Mitarbeit bei System-Upgrades, Migrationen und der Weiterentwicklung der IT-Infrastruktur . Erstellung und Pflege von technischen Dokumentationen, Prozessen und internen IT-Richtlinien . Unterstützung und Schulung der Anwender bei der Einführung neuer Tools und Technologien. Ihr Profil Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium im IT-Bereich bzw. vergleichbare Berufserfahrung. Mindestens 2–3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im IT-Support, als Systemadministrator, Netzwerkadministrator oder in einer vergleichbaren Position. Gute Erfahrung im Level-2-Support und Troubleshooting . Gute Kenntnisse in der System- und Serveradministration . Erfahrung mit Virtualisierungstechnologien, idealerweise VMware . Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind für diese Position zwingend erforderlich. Gute Englisch- und/oder Französischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil. Selbstständige, proaktive und flexible Arbeitsweise sowie gute Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit. Wir bieten Einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag . Eine abwechslungsreiche technische Position in einem internationalen Industrieumfeld . Ein attraktives Vergütungspaket. Gute Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung .

review_candidates.title: Technology Support Analyst II
review_candidates.description: About Kirkland & Ellis At Kirkland & Ellis, we don’t just meet the standard for legal excellence — we set it. Our culture is built on teamwork, ingenuity and an unwavering commitment to continuous growth. We tackle the most sophisticated legal challenges with bold ideas and innovative solutions, powered by the exceptional experience and ambition of our 7,000+ people, including 4,000+ attorneys, across 24 offices worldwide. Our dedicated professionals share our lawyers’ commitment to excellence and show up each day to do meaningful work that helps drive global business, investment and innovation forward. What You’ll Do Are you a customer-focused technology professional who thrives on solving complex technical issues, supporting end users, and delivering exceptional service in a fast-paced environment? As a Technology Support Analyst II , you will play a critical role in keeping employees connected, productive, and supported through reliable desktop, laptop, mobile, and conference technology services. Working across a modern technology environment, you'll troubleshoot and resolve technical issues, support collaboration tools, assist with conference and event technology, and partner with technical teams to ensure a seamless user experience. This role is ideal for a driven problem solver who combines strong technical expertise with excellent communication skills, sound judgment, and a commitment to outstanding customer service. The position requires full-time, on-site support and participation in firm-wide maintenance activities, including occasional overtime during technology deployments and maintenance windows. Provide End-User Support: Diagnose, troubleshoot, repair, maintain, and upgrade desktop and laptop hardware, software, and related technologies. Resolve Technical Issues: Assess user-reported problems, apply effective troubleshooting methodologies, and drive issues to resolution through direct support or appropriate escalation. Support Microsoft Technologies: Maintain and troubleshoot Microsoft Windows 11, Microsoft 365 (M365), OneDrive, and other business-critical applications. Manage Remote Access Solutions: Support remote computing environments, including Citrix XenDesktop and secure connectivity tools. Support Mobile Technology: Configure and troubleshoot Apple iOS devices, including iPhones and iPads. Assist with Network Connectivity: Troubleshoot wired and wireless network-related issues affecting user productivity. Support Voice Technologies: Provide assistance with Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) phone systems and related communication technologies. Own and Manage Service Requests: Accurately document incidents, service requests, and resolutions using ServiceNow while following ticket ownership and service delivery standards. Create and Maintain Documentation: Document solutions, procedures, best practices, and technical discoveries to support knowledge sharing and operational excellence. Collaborate Across Teams: Partner with technical teams and colleagues to resolve complex issues and improve support processes. Support Conference & Meeting Technology: Set up, troubleshoot, and maintain audio, video, and presentation technologies in conference rooms and event spaces. Enable Hybrid Collaboration: Configure and support Zoom, WebEx, and Microsoft Teams meetings, events, and remote collaboration experiences. Manage Audiovisual Equipment: Set up projectors, screens, microphones, speakerphones, sound systems, and video conferencing equipment. Support Conference Center Operations: Assist with the day-to-day technology needs of conference rooms and event spaces to ensure successful meetings and presentations. Participate in Technology Rollouts: Follow established procedures, quality controls, and project checklists while supporting technology deployments and upgrades. Provide On-Call Support: Participate in maintenance windows, on-call rotations, and occasional after-hours support as business needs require. What You’ll Bring Education & Certifications: Degree, diploma, or technical qualification in Computer Science or a related field preferred. CompTIA A+ and/or Microsoft certifications are highly desirable. Relevant Experience: 3 to 4 years of experience supporting end-user technology in a professional services environment; law firm experience is a plus. Desktop Support Expertise: Strong knowledge of desktop computing environments, hardware and software troubleshooting, operating systems, and peripheral devices. Microsoft Technology Skills: Experience supporting Windows 11, Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, Microsoft Authenticator, and Microsoft Entra multifactor authentication solutions. Endpoint & Device Management: Experience supporting Mobile Device Management (MDM), System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM), encryption technologies, and endpoint security tools. Service Management Knowledge: Familiarity with ticketing platforms, particularly ServiceNow, and a strong commitment to process-driven support. Collaboration & Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users. Customer-Focused Mindset: Strong interpersonal skills and a commitment to delivering a positive, professional support experience. Research & Problem-Solving: Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting abilities, and the initiative to research solutions using internal and external resources. Adaptability & Teamwork: Ability to manage competing priorities, remain flexible in high-pressure situations, and contribute positively within a collaborative team environment. If you're passionate about delivering outstanding technology support, solving complex problems, and helping professionals stay productive, we’d love to hear from you for this Technology Support Analyst I opportunity! How to Apply Thank you for your interest in Kirkland & Ellis LLP. To complete an application and submit your resume, please click "Apply Now." Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others at Kirkland.
